faq_heading: Cliff Drive houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Cliff Drive sell for?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Cliff Drive between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,364,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.1% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Cliff Drive sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 13 houses that sold in Cliff Drive went for between $1,310,000 and $1,520,000, around a median of $1,364,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Cliff Drive sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 13 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.1% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: The median year built was 1968 for the 13 houses sold in Cliff Drive.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Cliff Drive usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Cliff Drive had 4 bedrooms, from the 13 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

What Cliff Drive houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

13 houses sold in Cliff Drive with a median price of $1,364,000 (the middle half sold between $1,310,000 and $1,520,000), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $514 per square foot, a median year built of 1968 and a median lot of 7,696 square feet.
How Cliff Drive compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Cliff Drive sold for $1,364,000, 9% below the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Cliff Drive houses took a median 16 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
